description: Round-3B long-prefill axis. mmlu/professional_law has the longest prefill in the entire dataset (Qwen p50 151 / p90 287 / max 593 tokens, from a metadata-only scan of all 99540 files) versus abstract_algebra which is 4-6x shorter. This gives a within-dataset sequence-length sensitivity axis. It is NOT long context: the dataset caps decode at 128 tokens, so the longest possible query is about 721 tokens, three orders of magnitude short of 1M.
